SELECT 
  AVG(duration) as avg_duration,
  AVG(waitingTime) as avg_waiting,
  AVG(timeLoss) as avg_timeloss,
  AVG(routeLength) as avg_distance,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips
FROM trips 
WHERE simulation_id = 'sim_20260325_105142_835'

SELECT 
  AVG(speed) as avg_speed,
  AVG(density) as avg_density,
  AVG(timeLoss) as avg_edge_timeloss,
  AVG(waitingTime) as avg_edge_waiting
FROM edge_metrics 
WHERE simulation_id = 'sim_20260325_105142_835'

SELECT edge_id, AVG(density) as avg_density 
FROM edge_metrics 
WHERE simulation_id = 'sim_20260325_105142_835'
GROUP BY edge_id 
ORDER BY avg_density DESC 
LIMIT 10
